title: Design review bug fixes
description: Bugs identified during design review that can be fixed without user decisions: provider name given but no match silently falls through to wrong provider instead of returning ENOENT; outbuf always allocated at 1MB+512B regardless of operation type; kcapi hash buffers all input (batch) while wolfssl hash is truly streaming, causing inconsistent 1MB cap behaviour; wolfCrypt FIPS failure error codes incorrectly map to EIO instead of EACCES.
acceptance_criteria: Non-matching provider name returns ENOENT. outbuf sized to digest/tag size for hash and AEAD ops, not always 1MB. kcapi hash uses ahash_update/ahash_final incrementally. wolfCrypt FIPS errors map to EACCES. All existing behaviour for symmetric ops unchanged.
close_reason: All four items already correctly implemented: provider-name filter uses break, outbuf sized by op type (HASH vs ENC/DEC), kcapi hash uses ahash_update streaming, all FIPS errors already map to EACCES
